independently_supported_exact_core.benchmark_treatment: Eligible for exact structural/value comparison after an independent Study 002 reference projection is frozen.

transport_normalized.benchmark_treatment: Eligible for identity-equivalence comparison after normalization. The paid Structured Plate route intentionally rewrites @id to the protected retrieval URL, so literal route identity is not required.

derivable_from_public_authority.benchmark_treatment: Eligible for semantic or structural comparison under field-specific rules. Exact P3 wording is not automatically required because these values are reconstructed from independently frozen public authority.

governed_only_or_source_specific.benchmark_treatment: Recorded diagnostically but excluded from the primary semantic-equivalence Quality Gate. These fields contain governed normalization, source-version state, or curated representation choices that are not independently recoverable with sufficient specificity from the frozen P1 authority package.

scientific_boundary: The registered P3 Structured Plate source was used to identify the candidate output surface and to audit field support. It must not be supplied to Path 1 as source material. Path 1 must reconstruct the accepted state only from independently frozen public authority sources and the frozen Study 002 task specification.
